checks.integrity: Dock rendering/full-height fader geometry, native musical contact mapping, R34/R35/R37 analysis and preparation, R41 framework paths and R42 browser layouts match the baseline.
checks.review: Self-review under the project rule against parallel agents. Legacy geometry checks exercise expanded handles. The new workspace checks exercise both 12-point and 44-point policies.

behaviour: The section editor is a bottom-attached in-deck overlay, with direct grab sizing and separate session heights per deck and orientation. The fixed performance dock stays outside it.
Hiding or resizing preserves draft/view identity. Cancel and Save discard the session. Save and landmark promotion require the captured track and load identity.
An unloaded or reloaded track closes its editor. Existing arrangement validation and manual locks remain unchanged. Opening/closing sends no seek or zoom command.
Quiet 12-point grab lanes replace 44-point labelled grips by default. Settings enables Large panel handles; VoiceOver also selects expanded grips. Musical targets remain separate from the grab lanes.
FX/EQ and action trays start closed. Empty decks reject opening and reclaim the action-tray width. Loaded decks can reopen controls explicitly.
The original iPad/Duo inside browser and front-phone selection rules remain unchanged.
limits: Touch feel, keyboard focus, draft Save/Cancel, landmark promotion and clean audio require Erik acceptance.
Memory lasts for the session. Expanded handles remain available in accessibility settings.
This test release does not establish full TDJ1 equivalence or gig acceptance.
